about.description: Peninsula Golf & Racquet Club, located on the Fort Morgan Peninsula of Gulf Shores, AL, provides a perfect blend of southern hospitality and championship golf. The 27-hole course delivers a playable and enjoyable layout for golfers of all skill levels, with brand-new Tiff Eagle greens that are fast, consistent and enjoyable.
about.elevator_pitch: A championship golf course with brand-new Tiff Eagle greens and southern hospitality in Gulf Shores, Alabama.
about.vibe: Upscale luxury golf club offering championship golf experience with recreational and fitness amenities
about.insider_tip: Recently upgraded with brand-new Tiff Eagle greens
